ko.title: 독자의 반란

en.title: Reader Rebellion at GeekNews
en.hook: GeekNews readers are flipping the script on Korean tech trends – a must‑read rebellion
key_takeaways: GeekNews shifts its content direction based on reader feedback
High‑engagement articles become bestsellers, forcing publishers to rethink strategies
The uprising signals a power shift in the Korean IT community, worth watching going forward
